author: Orion I
title: Parallel CNN with Transformer Encoder Pathway
abstract: This submission marks a shift from RNNs to Transformer-based architectures. Having reached a plateau with CNN-LSTM models, this experiment replaces the LSTM pathway in the SOTA parallel model (ID 733) with a Transformer encoder block. The hypothesis is that self-attention will more effectively model the complex, long-range dependencies in RNA sequences, overcoming the limitations of the LSTM and achieving a new level of performance.
